text.title: 回顾之后的信
text.situation:
三个月后，林和乔一起回顾工作。她曾在一个忙碌下午漏看一条留言，也帮助改进了交接本。错误是个挫折，并没有终结她的计划。她仍想从事社区活动工作，实现写在笔记本里的目标。乔问，如果以后有责任更多的岗位，她是否对晋升有兴趣。

搬往主楼
施工完成后，临时办公室将搬迁。中心会补偿搬迁期间商定的交通费用。请保留收据，如果通勤发生变化，向管理人员说明。

林：老同事说她被裁员了。商店关门，她的工作岗位也消失了。
乔：那是很不同的一种变化。她找到新工作了吗？
林：还没有，我会把中心下一张招聘告示发给她。她有不错的经验。
乔：也别忘了自己的计划。搬迁后，我们再谈下一步。

paragraphs.en: Three months later, Lin sat with Jo to review her work. She had missed one message during a busy afternoon, but she had also helped improve the handover book. The mistake was a setback, not the end of her plans. She still wanted to pursue work in community events and attain the goals she had written in her notebook. Jo asked whether she would be interested in a promotion when a more responsible role opened.

paragraphs.en:
Move to the main building
The temporary office will relocate after the building work is complete. The centre will compensate staff for agreed travel costs during the move. Please keep the receipts and speak to the administrator if your journey changes.

paragraphs.en:
Lin: My old colleague says she has been made redundant. The shop closed, so her job disappeared.
Jo: That is a very different kind of change. Has she found another role?
Lin: Not yet. I will send her the centre’s next notice. She has good experience.
Jo: And keep your own plans in view. We can talk about the next step after the move.

S06.J08.P01.cue: 描述林的困难和仍在坚持的目标。
acceptableAnswers: 漏看留言是个挫折，但她仍想从事这项事业并达到目标。

S06.J08.P02.cue: 解释可能的下一岗位和办公室搬迁。
acceptableAnswers: 林可能对晋升感兴趣。办公室会搬迁，中心会补偿商定的费用。

S06.J08.P03.cue: 说明林以前的同事为何失去了工作。
acceptableAnswers: 她因商店关闭而被裁员。

S06.J08.T01.cue: 社团必须搬到另一栋建筑。告诉成员搬往哪里。
acceptableAnswers: 社团将搬往新的社区建筑。
